title: Starry Night in Wheat Field
description: A woman with long dark curly hair lies on her back in a dense field of golden-brown wheat, wearing a flowing white dress. Her eyes are closed and arms are relaxed at her sides as she rests beneath a dark night sky filled with stars and streaking meteors.
